quality.Quality: Combined resolution + source. Don't also use {Resolution} or {Source} or you'll get duplicates.
quality.Resolution: Video resolution only (use instead of {Quality} if you want resolution and source separated)
quality.Source: Source only, e.g. BluRay, WEB-DL, HDTV (use instead of {Quality} if you want resolution and source separated)
quality.VideoDynamicRange: HDR / HDR10+ / DV / Dolby Vision, blank for SDR
